observations.body: In the third month Israel camps before Sinai; the LORD recalls carrying them from Egypt and names treasured possession, priestly kingdom, and holy nation if they hear and keep covenant.
observations.label: Israel arrives and answers the covenant invitation

observations.body: Israel arrives and answers the covenant invitation belongs to approach to mountain in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 19:1–8 supplies antecedent evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Before the assembly

observations.body: Horeb antecedents and the approach to Sinai prepare the Event without turning every wilderness scene into the public assembly.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 19:1–8 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Israel arrives and answers the covenant invitation prepares for the mountain encounter, but this passage does not yet contain the public covenant assembly.
